answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 3 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in reef, checked in echo, and umber exposes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 3609 identities would post 4207 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
